stage2_context_review: Las Palmas' large absence list weakened the direct home thesis and supported defensive uncertainty; Valladolid entered off a 3-1 win.
note: BTTS Yes won 2-2. Money and share strengthened while the price moved adversely from 1.85 to 1.90. This reinforces the need to read money/share, price and football context together rather than treating price direction in isolation.
